record.note: Prompts and model reasoning are not stored, so they are not here. Each call lists the tokens the model spent reasoning.

attempt.objective: A full game with no human player, played to Fall 1925 or a solo win.

messages.body: Let’s keep the peace this spring: I’ll keep F Trieste out of Venice, and ask that A Venice avoid Trieste and Tyrolia. I plan to move toward Serbia and Albania; are you willing to coordinate over Greece?

I propose a friendly Galicia arrangement: I’ll move A Vienna to Galicia, while you keep A Warsaw out of Galicia and move toward Ukraine. I’ll pursue Serbia and Albania; let me know if you have different plans.

I’m aiming for Serbia and Albania this spring and have no intention of moving against your home centers. What are your plans for Bulgaria and Greece? Let’s avoid an early conflict and discuss a Balkan arrangement.

England here. I propose we both stay out of the Channel and North Sea this spring. I will move my fleets north and keep Brest-area waters quiet. Are you planning to move into Belgium or Spain? I am happy to leave you the Iberian coast if you leave my islands alone.

England to Germany: I am not planning to attack you. I'd like to keep the North Sea open for my fleet to reach Norway and Denmark without conflict. Would you consider an understanding where you take Holland and Denmark and I take Norway and Sweden, and neither of us moves fleets into the other's zone?
I propose we keep the English Channel demilitarized this year: I’ll keep F Brest out of ENG, and ask that F London stay out of the Channel. What are your plans for Belgium and the North Sea?
Let’s avoid an early clash: I propose A Paris and A Munich stay out of Burgundy this spring. I’m interested in Belgium, so please tell me whether you intend to move there.
I suggest a quiet western border this year: I have no plans to move against you. What are your intentions for A Venice and the Tyrolia/Trieste area?

Germany here. I'm content to stay out of Scandinavia and Holland if you leave Berlin's neighbors alone. Would you consider keeping your fleets away from Prussia and Silesia? I'll keep my armies out of Warsaw and focus west against France.
I intend a cautious opening and will keep A Venice out of Trieste this turn. What are your plans for Serbia and Greece? I suggest we avoid a clash over Trieste and coordinate our Balkan ambitions.
What are your plans for Greece and the eastern Mediterranean? I may send F Naples to the Ionian Sea; let's avoid an early clash there and discuss how to keep the Balkans open.
I have no designs westward this turn. I suggest we keep the western Mediterranean quiet while each of us pursues nearby neutral centers; are you planning any moves that affect the western Med?

Russia here. Your fleet in Ankara and army in Smyrna face no threat from me if you stay out of the Black Sea and leave Sevastopol alone. I'd like you to take Greece and Rumania in 1901 rather than move toward Armenia against me. Can we agree on that?
Russia to Austria: I propose you take Serbia and Rumania while I hold Galicia's border quiet. If you move on Warsaw or Ukraine I will respond. What are your plans for Trieste and Venice this year?

Russia to Germany: I am not planning to attack Prussia or Berlin in 1901. I'd like to know if you intend to move on Warsaw or Silesia. A neutral eastern border would let us both focus on the west and south.

Let’s keep the Black Sea demilitarized this year: I’ll move F Ankara to Constantinople, not the Black Sea, if you keep F Sevastopol out. Are you open to a non-aggression understanding in the Balkans while we both expand elsewhere?
I propose a 1901 non-aggression understanding: I won’t move into Serbia or Greece, and ask that you keep out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. We can discuss a Balkan arrangement before Fall.
Let’s avoid an early clash in the eastern Mediterranean. I propose you keep F Naples out of the Ionian and Aegean this year, while I keep F Ankara out of the Aegean. What are your plans?

I’ll keep to our Galicia arrangement: A Vienna to Galicia, with A Warsaw staying out and your A Moscow moving to Ukraine. I plan to take Serbia and seek Albania; I’ll keep F Trieste out of Venice. Let’s avoid a clash and revisit the Balkan balance in the fall.

I’ll pursue Serbia and Albania, and keep F Trieste out of Venice as agreed. I’m open to coordinating over Greece, but Turkey has proposed staying out of both Serbia and Greece; are you considering a move there? Please keep A Venice out of Trieste and Tyrolia.

I accept the 1901 non-aggression understanding: I’ll stay out of Bulgaria and Constantinople, and ask you to stay out of Serbia and Greece. I intend to move toward Serbia and Albania. Let’s discuss the fall plans for Bulgaria and Greece before orders.

England here. Agreed: neither of us moves into the English Channel this spring. My F London stays in the Channel-adjacent north and my fleets head to the North Sea and Norway. I am not planning to move into Belgium this year. If you keep Brest out of the Channel and away from my islands, we can both focus on expansion elsewhere. Let's keep this understanding for 1901.

I’ll keep F Brest out of the Channel and plan to take Spain; I’m also interested in Belgium, though I won’t move there if you’re contesting it. Please keep F London out of the Channel as proposed, and tell me whether you’re aiming for Belgium or the North Sea.

Agreed: I have no plans against Italy or the western Mediterranean this turn. My immediate aims are Spain and possibly Belgium. Please keep A Venice out of Tyrolia, and let me know if you intend to move A Venice to Piedmont.

Germany to England: Agreed in principle. I'll keep fleets out of the North Sea and Norway, and I'm focused on Holland and Denmark for now. Please keep your fleets out of Denmark and the Baltic approaches to Kiel, and we can both prosper.

Germany to Russia: Neutral eastern border suits me. I will not move into Warsaw or Silesia this spring, and I expect the same for Prussia and Berlin. Let's both pursue the west and south, and keep fleets out of the Baltic approaches to Kiel.

Germany to France: Burgundy stays quiet from my side this spring if you keep Paris and Marseille off Munich's route. I intend to move toward Belgium and Holland, so I'd rather we not both contest Belgium. Let's discuss a split later.

A Venice will stay clear of Tyrolia and Trieste this spring; I have no western designs. F Naples may head east toward the Ionian, and I intend to keep the western Mediterranean quiet. What are your plans for Spain and the western Mediterranean?

Agreed: A Venice will avoid both Trieste and Tyrolia, and F Trieste should stay clear of Venice. I’m considering F Naples to the Ionian, with Greece as a possible later goal. Please pursue Serbia; let’s compare plans for Greece before fall rather than risk a clash.

I share your wish to avoid an early clash, and I have no plans for the Aegean. I am considering F Naples toward the Ionian, chiefly to keep options open for Tunis and Greece; I hope you will keep F Ankara out of the Ionian and we can discuss Greece before fall.

Russia here. Agreed in principle: I won't move on Prussia or Berlin in 1901. I'm keeping Warsaw and Sevastopol defensive this year. I'd ask that you not move A Munich or F Kiel toward Silesia or Warsaw, and that we both watch the west while I focus south and east.

Russia here. Galicia sounds workable, but I'll need Warsaw to hold my own options. I'm willing to leave Serbia and Rumania to you this year, and I won't push into Galicia against your Vienna move. Please don't shift Trieste or Budapest toward Ukraine or Sevastopol. Let's keep our border calm for 1901.

Russia here. Deal: keep F Ankara to Constantinople, and I'll keep F Sevastopol out of the Black Sea. Greece and Rumania are fine for you in 1901. I expect no Turkish fleet or army moving toward Armenia or Sevastopol. Let's keep this understanding through the year.

Agreed: F Ankara will go to Constantinople, and I will leave the Black Sea and Sevastopol alone. I’m not planning to contest Rumania; I do want Bulgaria as my Balkan expansion. Let’s keep the border quiet and revisit the rest after the autumn.

I intend to avoid Serbia and Greece this spring and keep F Ankara out of the Aegean. I do want Bulgaria, so please keep your units out of it and Constantinople. Your plans for Serbia and Albania suit me; let’s revisit Greece before Fall.

I plan to keep F Ankara out of the Aegean and avoid an early clash. Please keep F Naples out of the Ionian and Aegean this year. I’m looking toward Bulgaria, not a move against Italy; let’s keep the eastern Mediterranean open.

I propose we coordinate Greece: I can have F Albania support your F Ionian Sea to Greece, leaving you the center without a clash. Please confirm you’ll keep A Venice clear of Trieste and Tyrolia; I’ll keep my fleet out of the Adriatic.

I intend to take Rumania with A Serbia this fall, as agreed. I’ll keep A Galicia out of Ukraine and avoid pressure on your home centers. Please keep F Sevastopol and A Warsaw clear of Rumania and Galicia.

I’ll honor our arrangement and stay out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. I plan A Serbia to Rumania and am willing to support Italy’s move to Greece from Albania if you remain clear of Serbia and Greece. Let’s keep the Balkan border quiet.

England to France: Fall 1901. Your F Mao and A Spa are near my western approaches. I will keep F London out of the Channel and hold my fleets north. Please confirm Brest stays out of the Channel and that you will not move into Belgium while I am positioned there, so we avoid a bounce.
France will not contest Belgium this fall; please take it with your units. I’ll secure Spain and Portugal. Let’s keep Burgundy and Munich quiet and avoid any move toward Burgundy from either side.
I’ll keep F Brest out of the Channel and focus on Portugal this fall. Are you still staying out of Belgium, and what are your plans for F North Sea and Norway?
I remain focused west and have no plans against Italy or the western Mediterranean. Please keep A Venice clear of Piedmont and Tyrolia; are you maintaining that quiet border this fall?

Germany to France: Holland and Belgium are my focus now. Your A Spa and F Mao are free to take Portugal and the Iberian coast. Will you keep A Bur out of Munich and Ruhr, and leave Belgium to me this fall? I will not move into Burgundy.
I propose Italy take Greece with F Ionian→Greece this fall while you secure Serbia. Please keep F Albania and A Serbia out of Greece; I’ll keep A Venice clear of Trieste and Tyrolia.
I intend F Ionian→Greece this fall. Please keep A Bulgaria out of Greece; I’ll avoid the Aegean and won’t move against your home centers.

I remain committed to a quiet western border and have no plans against you. Italy’s immediate focus is Greece and Tunis; please let me know if your plans for Spain or the western Mediterranean change.

Russia here. Our understanding holds: keep F Ankara on Constantinople and stay out of the Black Sea. You now hold Bulgaria with A Bulgaria, so I'd ask A Armenia not to advance toward Sevastopol. Rumania is open for your later moves, but please confirm no fleet heads north through the Black Sea this fall.
I’ll keep my army out of Serbia and leave your units in Serbia and Albania alone. I plan to move A Bulgaria to Greece this fall; please keep your units out of Greece and Bulgaria.
I plan to move A Bulgaria to Greece this fall. Please keep F Ionian Sea out of Greece, and I’ll keep F Constantinople out of the Aegean. Can we avoid a clash over Greece?

I’ll honor our understanding and keep F Constantinople out of the Black Sea; I’m not moving against Sevastopol or Rumania. I plan to move A Bulgaria to Greece this fall. Please keep F Sevastopol out of the Black Sea.

I’m supporting Italy’s F Ionian Sea→Greece from F Albania, so A Bulgaria→Greece will bounce unless you add support. Please keep A Bulgaria in place or move elsewhere; I’ll keep A Serbia→Rumania and stay out of Bulgaria and Constantinople.
Agreed: F Albania will support F Ionian Sea→Greece, and A Serbia will move to Rumania. Keep A Venice clear of Trieste and Tyrolia as proposed; I’ll keep my fleet out of the Adriatic.

England to France: Confirmed, I will keep F London out of the Channel and hold my northern fleets. I have no plans to enter Belgium this fall, so you are free to pursue Portugal. F North Sea and Norway are moving north for my own expansion, so please keep your fleets out of the North Sea and Norway and we will both gain.
Confirmed: A Burgundy will stay out of Munich and Ruhr, and I will not contest Belgium this fall. I’ll take Portugal and secure Spain; let’s keep our western land border quiet.

Confirmed: F Brest (now in MAO) will stay out of the English Channel, and I will not move to Belgium this fall. I’m taking Portugal and securing Spain. I appreciate you keeping F London out of the Channel.
My plans remain focused on Portugal and Spain; I have no western Mediterranean move against you. Please keep A Venice clear of Piedmont and Tyrolia as agreed.

Germany to France: Good, we have an understanding. I will take Belgium this fall with A Ruh and F Hol, and I won't move into Burgundy. Please keep A Bur out of Munich and Ruhr, and I'll do the same. Let's keep the western border quiet while you take Spain and Portugal.
I intend F Ionian Sea→Greece this fall, so A Bulgaria→Greece would cause a needless bounce. Please keep A Bulgaria out of Greece; I’ll avoid the Aegean and won’t move against your home centers.
Agreed: I’ll keep A Venice out of Trieste and Tyrolia. Please support F Ionian Sea→Greece with F Albania as proposed, and keep A Serbia out of Greece; that gives us Greece without a clash.
Yes, A Venice will stay clear of Piedmont and Tyrolia. I’m focused on Greece and Tunis, with no plans against France or the western Mediterranean.

Russia here. Agreed: F Constantinople stays out of the Black Sea and I keep F Sevastopol out too. Bulgaria to Greece is fine by me. Please keep A Armenia away from Sevastopol and Moscow's southern flank. We have a deal while we both expand toward the Aegean and Rumania.
Confirmed: F Constantinople will stay out of the Black Sea this fall, and I will not move against Sevastopol or Rumania. I’m moving A Bulgaria to Greece; our agreement remains intact.

I can’t leave Greece open: A Bulgaria is moving there, with F Constantinople available to support. Please keep F Ionian in place or redirect it; a supported attack risks a needless bounce and damages our chance to keep the eastern Mediterranean calm.

Please do not support Italy into Greece. I’m moving A Bulgaria there, and F Constantinople can support it; your support would cause a needless standoff and undermine our Balkan arrangement. I’ll continue to respect your hold on Serbia and Albania.

Turkey has A Bulgaria and fleets in Constantinople and the Aegean. Would you support my A Rumania→Bulgaria with F Greece this spring? I’ll keep F Albania out of Greece and avoid Trieste and Venice; please keep A Venice clear of Trieste and Tyrolia.

Let’s keep our Galicia understanding in place this spring: I’ll keep A Galicia out of your territory. What are your plans for A Warsaw and F Sevastopol? I’m considering pressure on Turkey from Rumania and would welcome coordination rather than a move against Galicia.

Your new fleet in Constantinople and A Bulgaria put pressure on the Balkans. What are your plans for Bulgaria and Greece this spring? I’d prefer to keep our border quiet, but I’ll need to protect Rumania and Serbia if you move west.

England to France: Spring 1902. Your A Spa and F Por are fine by me. I still want F Lon-area waters quiet and my fleets in the North Sea and Norway. Are you moving into Belgium this spring? If not, I will keep my fleet out of Belgium too. Please confirm Brest stays out of the Channel.

England to Germany: Your Holland and Denmark plans are fine by me. I'm moving F Nor and F Nth north and east, away from Kiel. Please keep your fleets out of Norway and the North Sea, and let me know if you plan to contest Belgium, since I may need to bounce or support there.

England to Russia: I have no quarrel with you in the north. My fleets are aimed at Norway and the North Sea, not Sweden or St Petersburg. If you keep F Swe and A Stp away from Norway, I will not interfere in the Baltic. What are your plans for Scandinavia and Germany this year?

France will keep A Paris out of Munich and A Gascony out of Ruhr this spring. What are your plans for A Belgium and A Ruhr? I suggest we keep Burgundy clear and coordinate rather than contest Belgium; I may need to move A Paris toward Picardy.

I’ll keep F Portugal out of the English Channel and won’t challenge your northern fleets. Are you planning to move F North Sea or another unit to Belgium this spring? I intend to keep the Channel quiet, as agreed.

I remain focused west and have no plans against Italy. Please confirm A Venice will stay clear of Piedmont and Tyrolia; what are your intentions for A Tuscany and the western Mediterranean this spring?

Germany to France: Confirming our deal. I take Belgium with A Ruh and F Hol this spring. Please keep A Bur out of Munich and Ruhr, and I'll stay out of Burgundy. Will you keep A Mar and A Par away from Munich?

Germany to Russia: Your F Swe and A War are close to my borders. Please keep F Swe out of Denmark and Kiel's approaches, and A War out of Silesia. I'm holding Berlin and Munich defensively. Can you confirm you're focused on Turkey and Austria this spring?

I hold Greece and intend to keep A Venice out of Trieste and Tyrolia. What are your plans for F Albania and the Balkans this spring? I’d like to avoid a clash over Greece while I arrange a move toward Tunis.

I hold Greece and am looking to secure Tunis, not attack your home centers. What are your plans for A Bulgaria and F Constantinople this spring? Let’s avoid a contest over Greece and keep the eastern Mediterranean from becoming an early front.

I’m keeping Italy’s western border quiet and have no plans against France. I’m focused on Tunis and the Balkans; please let me know if you foresee any western Mediterranean moves that could affect that.

Russia here. Rumania is now contested: your A Galicia and A Rumania both sit near my border. Please confirm A Rumania stays put or moves to Serbia, and that A Galicia does not enter Ukraine or Warsaw this spring. I'll keep A Warsaw and F Sevastopol in place.

Our 1901 understanding kept you out of Bulgaria and me out of Serbia and Greece. With your A Rumania and A Galicia now on my border, can we renew that arrangement? I propose you keep both out of Bulgaria while I avoid Serbia; what are your spring plans?

Your F Greece held the center last fall. I won’t force a needless bounce this spring: are you keeping F Greece there, and what are your plans for F Naples and F Aegean? I’d like to keep the eastern Mediterranean calm, but need room to expand.

Can we renew our Black Sea understanding this year—my F Constantinople stays out, and your F Sevastopol stays out? What are your plans for A Rumania and the southern border? I’m looking for a quiet frontier while I expand in the Balkans.

A Rumania will stay out of your territory this spring, and A Galicia will not enter Ukraine or Warsaw. I’m considering A Rumania to Bulgaria, so please keep F Sevastopol and A Warsaw clear of Rumania. What are your plans for them?

I’ll keep F Albania out of Greece and avoid Trieste and Venice. I’m considering A Rumania to Bulgaria and would welcome F Greece supporting it; that would pressure Turkey without a clash over Greece. Can you support? I’ll keep A Serbia out of Greece.

I’ll keep A Galicia and A Rumania out of Bulgaria this spring, and I have no plan to enter Constantinople. I intend to protect Serbia and keep F Albania out of Greece. Please keep A Bulgaria out of Serbia and leave Rumania alone; then we can maintain a quiet border.

England to France: Thanks, Portugal and Spain are yours. I am not moving into Belgium this spring, and my fleets stay in the North Sea and Norway. Please keep F Portugal and your Brest-area units out of the Channel and off my islands, and we will both keep expanding.

I’ll keep Paris and Gascony out of Munich and Ruhr, and Burgundy clear. I’m not contesting Belgium this spring; you may take it. I may move Paris to Picardy, so please keep your units clear of Burgundy and avoid pushing toward the French border.

Confirmed: F Portugal stays out of the Channel, and I won’t move to Belgium this spring. Please keep your northern fleets out of the Channel and leave Belgium open for Germany. I’ll keep our western approaches quiet.
No western Mediterranean moves are planned against you. I’ll keep to the Iberian coast; please keep A Venice clear of Piedmont and Tyrolia as agreed. What route is A Tuscany taking this spring?

Germany to England: Understood. I keep fleets out of the North Sea and Norway. I plan to move F Hol and A Ruh into Belgium this spring, so please don't support or contest there. Keep your fleets out of Denmark and Kiel's approaches and we stay friends.

I’ll keep F Greece in place this spring and have no plan to move F Naples against you; F Naples is focused on Tunis. I’d prefer we avoid a fight over Greece. What expansion are you considering for A Bulgaria and F Constantinople?
A Venice will stay clear of Piedmont and Tyrolia. A Tuscany is not moving west, and I have no western Mediterranean designs; F Naples is focused on Tunis. I intend to keep the border quiet.

I can support A Rumania→Bulgaria with F Greece, provided you keep F Albania out of Greece and avoid Trieste and Venice as you say. I’ll keep A Venice out of Trieste and Tyrolia. Let’s coordinate the Balkans and avoid creating a front with Turkey.

Russia to Germany: I have no plans against Berlin or Munich this spring. F Swe will not enter Denmark or Kiel's approaches, and A War stays out of Silesia. I am focused on Rumania and the south. Keep your own eastern garrisons where they are and we will get on fine.

Russia to England: Noted. F Swe and A Stp will not head toward Norway this spring. In return, keep your fleets out of the Baltic and the Gulf of Bothnia. Our interests are in the south and east, so I see no reason for conflict in the north.

Russia to Turkey: Yes, the Black Sea understanding stands. F Con stays out of the Black Sea and F Sev stays put. On Rumania, I am contesting it with Austria, so I cannot promise you that centre. Keep A Armenia away from Sevastopol and Moscow and we remain at peace.

Russia to Austria: Galicia stays out of my territory and I will hold A War and F Sev in place. Rumania is the problem: your A Galicia and A Rumania both sit on my border. Move A Rumania to Serbia or hold, and we can coordinate on Turkey without clashing in the north.

I’ll leave F Greece alone this spring and won’t send F Constantinople into the Aegean. I’m considering A Bulgaria’s next move, so please keep F Greece from supporting Austria into Bulgaria. I have no immediate plans against your home centers; I’d like to avoid a needless eastern Mediterranean front.

I’ll avoid Serbia this spring, but I can’t promise to keep A Bulgaria out of Bulgaria or leave it undefended. I have no immediate plan to attack your centers. Please keep A Rumania and A Galicia out of Bulgaria, and tell me whether you intend to hold Rumania or move west.

Can F Greece support A Rumania→Bulgaria this fall? I’ll keep F Albania out of Greece and A Serbia out of your way; please keep A Venice clear of Trieste and Tyrolia. With A Bulgaria in place, coordinated support is our best chance to dislodge Turkey.

I intend to protect Serbia and Rumania this fall. Your A Bulgaria and fleets remain a threat; are you planning to move against Rumania or Serbia? I’m considering pressure on Bulgaria with Italian support, and would prefer a clear understanding rather than a Balkan clash.

A Galicia is no longer on the board; my units are in Bohemia and Silesia, and I’ll keep them out of your territory. Please keep A Warsaw and F Sevastopol clear of Rumania as we focus on the Turkish position.

England to Germany: Fall 1902. Belgium is now yours to take or hold; I will not contest it. Our northern fleets stay out of Denmark, Kiel and Holland. In return, please keep your fleets out of the North Sea and Norway. Are you planning any move against Denmark this fall?

England to France: Fall 1902. I am keeping F London and my northern fleets off the Channel and out of Belgium. Please confirm Brest and Portugal stay out of the Channel and that Spain stays yours. If you plan to move against Belgium, tell me now so we avoid a bounce.

England to Russia: Fall 1902. I remain out of the Baltic and Gulf of Bothnia. Please keep your fleets out of Norway and the North Sea, and tell me whether you intend Sweden or Scandinavia against me. I would rather we both expand south and east.

What are your Fall plans for A Belgium, A Ruhr, and A Munich? I’m not committing to a move on Belgium this turn, but would like to discuss a stable border and future expansion. I’ll keep A Picardy and A Piedmont out of your home centers if you keep your units out of Burgundy.
I’ll keep F MAO out of the Channel and won’t contest Belgium this turn. What are F North Sea and F Norway doing this fall? Please keep the Channel and my northern coast quiet while I secure Iberia.

I intend to keep France’s units away from Italy this fall. Are A Tuscany and F Naples still focused east, and will A Venice remain clear of Piedmont and Tyrolia? Let’s maintain the quiet western border.

Germany to France: Belgium is now mine, as agreed. Note that A Bel is already mine and I hold Holland. Please keep A Bur out of Munich and Ruhr, and I will stay out of Burgundy. With Spain and Portugal yours, let's keep the western border quiet while we each look elsewhere.

Germany to Russia: Thanks for keeping F Swe out of Denmark and Kiel's approaches. I'm holding Berlin and Munich and have no plans against Warsaw or Silesia. Your focus on Rumania and the south suits me. Please confirm A War stays out of Silesia and Prussia while we both pursue our own fronts.

I’m prioritizing F Naples→Tunis and will keep F Greece in place; I can’t support an attack on Bulgaria this fall. What are your plans for A Rumania and F Albania? I’ll keep A Venice clear of Trieste and Tyrolia as agreed.

I intend to keep F Greece in place and send F Naples toward Tunis, not against your home centers. Please keep A Bulgaria and your fleets out of Greece this fall. What are your plans for Bulgaria and the Aegean?
I’m sending F Naples toward Tunis and will keep A Venice clear of Piedmont and Tyrolia. I have no western moves planned against you; are your fleets staying focused on Iberia this fall?

Russia to Austria: Rumania is the key issue. Your A Rumania and A Galicia sit on my border. If you move A Rumania to Serbia or hold, I'll keep A Warsaw and F Sevastopol out of Rumania and Galicia. Will you confirm A Galicia stays out of Ukraine this fall?

With Serbia apparently open, I’m considering A Bulgaria→Serbia this fall. Will you keep F Albania from supporting a defense there? I’ll continue to keep A Bulgaria out of Rumania and avoid your home centers if we can maintain a quiet border.

Is F Greece holding this fall, or do you plan to move it? I’m considering A Bulgaria→Serbia and would rather avoid a Greece fight; please don’t support Austria into Bulgaria. I’ll keep F Aegean out of the Ionian and avoid your home centers.

The Black Sea arrangement still works for me: F Ankara stays out, and I ask F Sevastopol to stay out as well. I’m considering A Bulgaria→Serbia this fall; are you still contesting Rumania with Austria, and do you plan any move toward Armenia or Constantinople?

Confirmed: A Galicia is no longer on the board, and my units in Bohemia and Silesia will stay out of your territory. I’ll keep A Rumania out of your centers; please keep Warsaw and Sevastopol clear of Rumania.

I’ll keep F Albania out of Greece and A Venice clear of Trieste and Tyrolia. Since you can’t support Bulgaria this fall, I’ll focus on protecting Serbia and Rumania. Please keep F Greece in place as planned.

I will protect Serbia. F Albania will not support a defense there, but I cannot agree to leave Serbia undefended: I may move A Rumania there. Keep A Bulgaria out of Serbia and Rumania, and we can avoid a clash.

England to France: Thanks. F North Sea and F Norway are moving north and east for my own expansion, not toward your coast. Keep F Mao and Brest out of the Channel and away from Ireland and my islands, and we will both gain. I will not contest Belgium this fall, but I expect the same courtesy in the North Sea and Norway.

I’ll keep A Picardy and A Piedmont out of Munich and Ruhr, and expect you to keep your units out of Burgundy. I’m not contesting Belgium this fall. What are A Belgium and A Munich doing? Let’s keep the border stable while we expand elsewhere.

Confirmed: F MAO stays out of the Channel, and I won’t contest Belgium. Spain remains mine. Please keep your fleets away from the Channel and my northern coast; what are F North Sea and F Norway doing this fall?
My fleets remain focused on Iberia; I have no moves against Italy this fall. Please keep A Venice clear of Piedmont and Tyrolia as agreed. Are F Naples and A Tuscany staying focused east?

Germany to England: Denmark is on my list for later, but I have no fall move against it yet. I'll keep my fleets out of the North Sea and Norway as agreed. Please keep your fleets out of Denmark, Kiel and Holland, and let's both see how the south develops.

Germany to France: Belgium is mine and I hold Holland, so we have no quarrel there. I will keep A Mun and A Ruh out of Burgundy and I expect A Bur to stay out of Munich and Ruhr. Let's keep the western border quiet while you take Spain and Portugal. Please confirm A Pie and A Pic stay away from Munich and Berlin.
I can’t support Rumania→Bulgaria this fall; F Greece will hold as promised. I’ll keep A Venice clear of Trieste and Tyrolia, and F Naples is moving toward Tunis. Please keep F Albania out of Greece.
A Tuscany remains away from your border, and F Naples is moving toward Tunis. A Venice will stay clear of Piedmont and Tyrolia. I appreciate France keeping its units away from Italy.

F Greece will hold, and I won’t support Austria into Bulgaria. F Naples is headed toward Tunis, not your home centers. Your plan to move A Bulgaria→Serbia is fine; please keep F Aegean out of Greece as well.

Russia to Germany: Confirmed. A War stays out of Silesia and Prussia this fall, and F Swe will not enter Denmark or Kiel's approaches. I am focused on Rumania and the south. Keep your eastern garrisons in place and we stay at peace.

Russia to England: Noted. F Swe and A Stp will not move toward Norway or the North Sea. Keep your fleets out of the Baltic and Gulf of Bothnia and we have no quarrel. I plan to expand south and east, not against you.

Russia to Austria: A Rumania remains my key concern. Moving it to Serbia or holding is what I need to see. If so, A Warsaw and F Sevastopol stay clear of Rumania and Galicia. A Galicia is gone, so please keep A Bohemia and A Silesia out of Warsaw and Ukraine.

Russia to Turkey: The Black Sea understanding stands: F Ankara stays out and F Sevastopol stays put. I am contesting Rumania with Austria, so I cannot promise it to you. A Bulgaria to Serbia is your business. Keep A Armenia away from Sevastopol and Moscow and we remain at peace.

F Greece should hold, and I’ll keep F Aegean out of the Ionian and away from Greece. A Bulgaria is considering Serbia, not Greece; please don’t support Austria into Bulgaria. I’ll leave your home centers alone.

I intend A Bulgaria→Serbia if it is open, and will keep it out of Rumania and your home centers. Please don’t use F Albania to support Bulgaria or otherwise force a Balkan clash. I’ll respect your defense of Rumania.

Your A Bulgaria remains a direct threat to Serbia and Rumania. What are your spring intentions? I propose you keep A Bulgaria out of Serbia and Rumania while I keep A Rumania out of Bulgaria; let’s avoid a Balkan clash this turn.
